review.official:
Before the
Chernobog
incident
, Zima was a middle school student. In school, she displayed a peculiar interest in fighting and violence. Multiple tests have shown she has the strength and solid constitution characteristic of the
Ursus race
. Currently, she leads a squad of
Vanguard
Operator
.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0% 
Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

[Blood Crystal Density] 0.1u/L 
This Operator has rarely come into contact with Originium.

Zima defies most people's preconceived notions what an Ursus should be, expecting her to be irascible and sensitive. When she has something to say, she says it directly, and doesn't much consider what kind of impact it's going to leave her targets. What is certain is that Zima feels her words and actions are acceptable. Even so, as soon as she feels like one of her friends is being bullied or treated unfairly, she will stick up for them regardless of the circumstances.
As a result, childish jokes should be kept to a minimum in her presence. As for dealing with young Operators, a flexible attitude must be maintained.
The short of it is that Operators should watch what they say around Zima. They should be somewhat honest, but also help Zima understand that she and Rhodes Island share mutual interests.

Zima was born in the city of Chernobog in the Empire of Ursus. Reports have indicated that in recent years, student groups have become a popular for young Ursus to organize. Influenced by the cultures of countries like Victoria and Columbia, they spend all day immersed in rock music, beer, and fight clubs. The leader of every group of students has their own nickname. Zima's first nickname was, appropriately, 'Zima,' a nickname given to her by the leader of the eastern campus's student group after she defeated him. A separate group called her 'General' (a derisive in-joke within that group - Ursans often joke that 'Generals' are incompetent and untrustworthy). However, after the annihilation of all the other student groups around the campus, people began to merge the two nicknames, and began to call her 'General Zima.'

It is clear that ever since the Chernobog incident, the surviving Ursus students have gathered in a loose group around Zima called the 'Ursus Student Self-government Group.' According to reports from some Operators, the students use Istina's room as a place to gather. They call it 'The Classroom.' We should maintain a schedule of periodic observations of this group's daily activities.

Zima's recent reading list: 
Nikolamina - Fine summer reading!
Jump! - Special Edition - One of the year's Top Ten Recommendations
The Death of Ilyich, the Suspect - (Recommended Genre: Detective Literature)
Friedrich's Theory of War - (Volkhov Press, reissued in October)
......
Despite how she seems, Zima does not show any indication of poor reading skills. The breadth of the genres she reads has left us with a deep impression. Perhaps we need to re-consider what we think of as popular literature among the middle school female population.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm here to help. So? Whose ass are we kicking next?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You can't go out without permission? Что? Aren't you the one in charge? Screw the rules, let's just get out.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You said something? My headphones were on.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The leader of Rhodes Island looks younger than even Istina. How can you let a kid like that go to battle?!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why do I stare at you all the time? 'cause I'm onto you, gotta see what you're doing.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …You really finished all your work?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not too bad.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't care if I'm leading or following. Whatever.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What a pain...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Roll out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Duh, it's me!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm heading into the thick of it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Spineless scumbags.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hah.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: What're you scared of?!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bring it on, bastards!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: For power and glory!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Victory or death!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Who else has a death wish? Happy to help!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not bad. A solid win.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Anyway, this place is ours now.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Man, you suck. Get lost!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What do you want me to do here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, you're getting better at giving orders these days. I bet you also see the fun in fighting now, eh?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Morning. Everyone's so damned noisy today. All those grown-ass people running around crazy excited for New Year's like a bunch of kids… Say, you aren't planning to waste the first day of the year sitting around here, are you? I bought a whole ton of fireworks, so you're gonna come have some fun with me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You need something?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Privet, this one's for you. Hey, who said you could open it right now? Whatever, not like it's anything special. It plays music, same model as mine. Gets the job done, as far as I'm concerned… You've had my back for a while, so a little token of appreciation is the least I can do. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island gave us a place to live. I'm not about to forget that. I'm gonna get stronger, strong enough to make sure I'm worthy of the 'General Zima' title - for my comrades. Now, you'd better work twice as hard from here on, or that chair's gonna be mine. I'm dead serious!
